headline_seed: Record-breaking May warmth soon to blow away as cold front moves towards eastern Australia
description_seed: Daytime temperatures on Friday were 10 to 14C above average in four states Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast Record-breaking warm temperatures for the start of May in many parts of the country will be washed out by a cold front bringing rain, thunderstorms and much cooler weather. A high-pressure system dragged warm northerly winds across south-east Australia, the Bureau of Meteorology (BoM) said. Continue reading...
